Real excerpts, not synthetic. Retrieved 2026-10-01.

oceansites_index_sample.txt
          Verbatim lines of the OceanSITES GDAC index, chosen to cover the traps the
          parser handles (latitude repeated in the longitude columns, "unknown"
          DATE_UPDATE, T24:00:00Z end times, short continuation fragments).
          Source: ftp://ftp.ifremer.fr/ifremer/oceansites/oceansites_index.txt
opendap/  .dds / .das / .ascii responses from the GDAC OPeNDAP server
          https://tds0.ifremer.fr/thredds/dodsC/CORIOLIS-OCEANSITES-GDAC-OBS/DATA/...
          Personal contact attributes in the .das files are replaced with "redacted";
          the attribute lines are kept so the parser sees the real structure.
Licence   OceanSITES data policy: free and unrestricted exchange, with the citation
          below. https://ocean-ops.org/oceansites/data/index.html

production_moorings.json
          30 station rows (reference, name, position) from the OceanOPS register as
          held in our database. OceanOPS data: all rights reserved; free for
          non-commercial use with acknowledgement of OceanOPS (ocean-ops.org/api/help).
          WITHHELD FROM THE PUBLIC MIRROR (scripts/export-public.sh NEVER_RULES): the
          package is offered commercially, these rows are not. Tests that load it skip
          when it is absent. See DATA-LICENCES.md.

These data were collected and made freely available by the international OceanSITES
project and the national programs that contribute to it.

adc_davis/  The Davis Strait moorings, NSF Arctic Data Center — doi:10.18739/A2416T169,
          "Davis Strait hydrographic mooring Level 2 data: temperature, salinity, and velocity
          measurements from the Davis Strait Observing System moorings, 2004 to 2022"
          (Lee, C., 2024), licence CC0 1.0 (the dataset's EML intellectualRights; DataCite carries
          no rightsList). Retrieved 2026-10-03.
          solr_listing.json  the REAL response of the DataONE Solr index
                https://arcticdata.io/metacat/d1/mn/v2/query/solr/ for the query the code sends
                (isDocumentedBy:"doi:10.18739/A2416T169" AND -obsoletedBy:*, fl limited to
                id,fileName,formatId,size,checksum,checksumAlgorithm,dateModified): 447 documents,
                446 netCDF files (261 MicroCAT, 85 RCM, 100 ADCP) and the EML.
          datacite.json      the DOI's DataCite record (api.datacite.org/dois/10.18739/a2416t169),
                the source of the citation text in ingestion/oceansites_adc.py.
          Davis_*_L2.nc      seven REAL files of that dataset, downloaded from the ADC object
                endpoint and cut in time (the first 200-300 samples, or a window that holds the
                file's real fill values and QC flags) with every variable, dimension and attribute
                kept verbatim. The cut changes the length of the data only: the global attributes
                (time_coverage_*, ...) still describe the whole real file, which is why a test
                that wants the coverage reads it from the 2007-2014 layout. What each one is for:
                BI4_2010_96m  the 2007-2014 layout (mooring_number = BI4, time_coverage as text);
                BI4_2004_151m the 2004-2006 layout (mooring_number = 1535, a numeric id; the site
                              is only in the `source` attribute; the salinity is flagged 4);
                BI4_2015_28m  the 2015 layout (no mooring_number, platform_id = BI4.30,
                              time_coverage_start an epoch number, no sensor_depth);
                RCM_velocity_C4_2013_500m  an RCM file whose coverage spans two seasons
                              (2013-09-16 .. 2015-09-11) and whose velocities turn into the
                              1e+35 fill with flag 9; one shared velocity_QC;
                RCM_velocity_C1_2015_234m  fills plus flags 4 and 9 in one window;
                MicroCAT_C5_2013_23m       a MicroCAT with a flagged sample;
                RCM_velocity_C6_2013_250m  every velocity is fill (flag 9): read fine, nothing to store.

adc_davis_register.json
          Six OceanOPS register rows (ref, name, position, deploy date: DS_BI4 x3, DS_C4 x2, DS_C6)
          copied from the production `oceansites_stations` table on 2026-10-03, for the database
          tests of the Arctic Data Center matching. OceanOPS terms as for production_moorings.json:
          WITHHELD FROM THE PUBLIC MIRROR (scripts/export-public.sh NEVER_RULES); the tests skip
          without it. See DATA-LICENCES.md.
